notes: Clean, fair puzzle. Each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and each constraint knocks out exactly one decoy, so a careful read lands on Linden Corner with no ambiguity.

Cyrus's peanut allergy is only implied (emergency pen + satay story + Roxy's 'nothing satay-adjacent'). It's a nice indirect clue and still solvable; the Slate Window review says 'satay-style dressing' and 'whole peanuts' outright, which links the two.

Mina's vegetarianism is never named. 'Zero meat' and 'meat-free spread' make it clear enough. Nothing points to vegan, and Linden's reviews only show vegetarian (no explicit vegan claim), so I read it as vegetarian.
Roxy's dairy intolerance is phrased obliquely ('stomach still not speaking to them'). Mina's setup line names milk, butter and cheese, so it is findable.
No budget is stated, but every venue is $, so price doesn't matter here. That's fine, but a player might go looking for a budget clue that isn't there.
Linden Corner shows peanut and dairy safety only through reviewers' anecdotes ('never once reached for it', 'never had to ask what's in anything'). That's consistent with the other cards and fair.
